name: iFi
tagline: Just a guy eating way too much ramen and tracking every bowl.
bio: Hi. I'm iFi. I live in Australia, I think in Korean, and I have spent a financially irresponsible amount of money flying to Japan to drink soup. This website is the result. Nobody asked for it. You're here anyway. Hi.

It started with a two-hour queue at Iruca. It has since escalated into 25+ bowls, a spreadsheet, a map with pins on it, and an on-and-off situation with Kamukura that my friends have described as 'concerning.'

My rating system is peer-reviewed by nobody: I eat the ramen, I stare out the train window thinking about the ramen, and then I give it a number. Good bamboo shoots get bonus points. I will not be taking questions about the bamboo shoots.
If I ever go missing, check the queue outside Ramen Shingen in Sapporo. I'm fine. I'm in the snow. I'm happy.
